items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I don't know whether it was Nile Morris.

ctx.x: He went out with Al Sears and Marlowe. I don't know whether it was Nile Morris. They had a thing going, they had a terrific band... We didn't know what they were doing because we had to take care of our things and it became hectic after '41, you know.
